messages:
paul_auditor: Morning team — auditor here. We need an evidence bundle for an emergency RBAC elevation tied to CVE triage on 2025-03-18. Please include: 1) authoritative IAM change events showing apply + revert, 2) KMS activity for alias/redwood-tempkey (keyId=zz99yy88-0000) during the window, 3) the vuln ticket (TRIAGE-2025-311), and 4) a short mapping to ISO/SOC controls. Can you produce a single package with checksums?

mira_sec: Hi Paul — yes. The bind was svc-triage -> infra-operator and lasted ~22 minutes. Ticket is TRIAGE-2025-311. We'll collect CloudTrail events and the GitOps PR that caused it.

devin_ops: I'll pull the CloudTrail eventIDs and the gitops PR diff (internal link). Splunk query I'm using:
```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/svc-triage" earliest="2025-03-18T10:45:00" latest="2025-03-18T11:15:00"
| table _time, eventName, eventID, requestParameters, responseElements
```
I'll export raw JSON and a summarized CSV.

ops-bot: Notice: detected change source -> gitops/pr#7210 merged at 2025-03-18T10:48:12Z; action: RoleBinding svc-triage->infra-operator.

mira_sec: For KMS, key alias/redwood-tempkey shows GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext then Decrypt at 2025-03-18T10:51:03Z and 10:52:07Z. I'll export CloudTrail JSON for keyId zz99yy88-0000 and a short CSV of calls.

paul_auditor: Originals are required for verification but redacted artifacts ok for initial upload. Please include: manifest (filename, sha256, eventID), redaction rules, and a note explaining why KMS ops were necessary. Include eventIDs in manifest so we can cross-check.

mira_sec: Understood. We'll build: manifest.csv, mapping.md (control -> artifact, e.g., SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9.2.3), redaction_script.sh, redacted/* and originals/* (originals gated). We'll HMAC the manifest with the compliance key and post HMAC+sha256.

devin_ops: ETA: I'll upload redacted package to s3://redwood-compliance/packages/TRIAGE-2025-311-redacted.tar.gz by EOD and post sha256. Originals staged at s3://redwood-compliance/originals/TRIAGE-2025-311/ with strict ACL.

paul_auditor: Good. Also include the PR approver list and the revert commit hash so we can show emergency approval + revert trace.

mira_sec: Will include approver CSV and timeline: 2025-03-18T10:42Z vuln reported; 10:46Z emergency PR opened; 10:48Z PR merged (bind applied); 11:10Z triage complete; 11:10:30Z revert PR merged.

devin_ops: Uploaded redacted package: s3://redwood-compliance/packages/TRIAGE-2025-311-redacted.tar.gz
sha256: c3a9f4b6d1e2f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123456789
HMAC(manifest): hmac-sha256: 5f6e7d8c9b0a1f2e3d4c5b6a7980f1e2d3c4b5a697887766554433221100ffee

paul_auditor: Received. I'll schedule onsite verification of originals under NDA. Please keep the originals ACL locked until reviewer access is arranged. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
